info.name: SENTRA — Tenant Isolation & Permission Enforcement
info.description:
Validates that the tenant_ownership_guard patch is correctly blocking cross-tenant IDOR attacks, enforcing member permission scoping, and preserving superuser bypass. Run 00·Setup first, then any folder independently.

Required collection variables (set before running):
  base_url            http://localhost:8000
  superuser_email     admin@sentra.local
  superuser_password  (from .env SUPERUSER_PASSWORD)
  admin_a_email       admin_a@acme.test
  admin_a_password    adminpassA1
  admin_b_email       admin_b@globex.test
  admin_b_password    adminpassB1
  member_routes_email    member_routes@acme.test
  member_routes_password memberpassR1
  member_domains_email   member_domains@acme.test
  member_domains_password memberpassD1
  member_noperms_email   member_audit@acme.test
  member_noperms_password memberpassN1
  garbage_token       thisisnotavalidjwt
